title: Design System: Joseph Vergara — Hand-Kept Engineering Notebook

designIntent.description: A personal portfolio that presents real project evidence through notebook paper, ruled lists, taped-in imagery, brief annotations, and measured technical details.

activeFontAliases.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, SF Pro Display, system-ui, sans-serif
activeFontAliases.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, system-ui, sans-serif
activeFontAliases.note: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, system-ui, sans-serif
activeFontAliases.mono: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace

knownDrift: The active primary palette is blue and neutral rather than maroon and gold.
The active font aliases resolve to system stacks; the layout-loaded display fonts are not selected by those aliases.
The foil token resolves to the theme surface, and the olive token resolves to green.
Some navigation and companion elements still use blur, gradients, or stronger shadows. This sync documents them without restyling the interface.

motion.name: tape-flex

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animations and transitions are effectively disabled.

components.name: Portfolio Navigation
components.description: Responsive section navigation with a mobile menu, visible focus states, and the current spatial-island/glass treatment.

components.name: Hero and Hardware Bench
components.description: Personal introduction and interactive hardware simulation. Keep simulated readings clearly distinguished from physical-device results.

components.name: Project Index
components.description: Search, category filters, date sorting, a featured photo print, ruled project entries with evidence-backed status chips, available links, and project detail dialogs.

components.name: Photo Print
components.description: White-edged imagery with a slight soft offset shadow and optional masking-tape decoration.

components.name: Project Dialog
components.description: Accessible project title, result when documented, description, status, technologies, and available repository/demo actions.

components.name: Certification Index
components.description: Featured credential, browsable entries, filters, and original document links when available.

components.name: Contact and Companion
components.description: Direct contact routes and an optional chat panel. Preserve keyboard access and reduced-motion behavior.

narrative.overview: The design direction and active implementation are recorded separately so the notebook concept stays clear without misreporting the shipped blue/neutral theme, system font aliases, or existing glass and gradient styles.
keyCharacteristics: Real project and academic evidence leads the page.
Quadrille, ruled lists, photo prints, masking tape, and short margin notes carry the notebook language.
Maroon and gold are intended identity colors, but are not currently wired as active theme colors.
Tabular mono is reserved for actual technical measurements.
Keyboard access, visible focus, responsive layouts, and reduced motion remain part of the system.

rules.name: Evidence First
rules.body: Project descriptions, roles, outcomes, dates, and status labels must be supported by evidence.

rules.name: One Quiet Rule
rules.body: Use the existing one-pixel border treatment for separators; hierarchy comes from spacing, type, and placement.

rules.name: Brief Margin Notes
rules.body: Keep handwritten-style notes short; prose and controls stay readable in the active text face.

rules.name: Record Implementation Drift
rules.body: Do not describe intended colors or fonts as active until source CSS selects them.

rules.name: Visible by Default
rules.body: Honor reduced motion and keep important content available without waiting for animation.

dos: Use real project previews and clear repository/demo links.
Keep project entries readable on narrow screens.
Reuse existing component patterns and tokens.
Document design intent separately from measured implementation.
donts: Do not claim undocumented roles, results, or project completion.
Do not expand the blue palette or add decorative effects during content-only work.
Do not describe loaded fonts as active without checking the CSS aliases.
Do not add dependencies or duplicate design systems for a visual update.
